name: SUPRICOM - Alerta Leads por Tiempo en Status

parameters.query:
SELECT 
  l.id,
  l.name,
  l.nombre_contacto,
  l.telefono,
  l.status,
  l.seller_id,
  l.whatsapp_link,
  l.ubicacion_estado,
  l.campana,
  l.fecha_ingreso,
  CASE 
    WHEN l.status = 'NUEVO' THEN l.fecha_ingreso
    ELSE COALESCE(
      (SELECT MAX(h.fecha_cambio) FROM leads_status_history h WHERE h.lead_id = l.id),
      l.updated_at
    )
  END AS fecha_ultimo_status
FROM leads l
WHERE 
  l.status NOT IN ('CERRADO', 'GANADO', 'PERDIDO')
  AND l.seller_id IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY fecha_ultimo_status ASC

SELECT 
  s.id AS seller_id,
  s.name AS seller_name,
  s.whatsapp AS seller_whatsapp,
  uc.email AS seller_email
FROM sellers s
INNER JOIN users_config uc ON s.user_id = uc.id
WHERE s.id = {{ $json.seller_id }}
AND s.activo = 1
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
  uc.email AS admin_email,
  uc.name AS admin_name
FROM users_config uc
WHERE uc.role_id = 8
LIMIT 1
